headline: Nothing to do before Nabers' Monday night kickoff — Tuesday morning move Caleb Williams to IR (hamstring, possibly out into November) and start Geno Smith at superflex.
summary: Every Robinsavages starter except Malik Nabers already played this week and is locked; Nabers carries no injury flag and stays in as started for tonight's 5:15 PM Monday-nighter. Caleb Williams stays locked as Out until Tuesday morning — an MRI-based outside estimate published today puts his hamstring at up to 8 weeks, so move him to IR then and start Geno Smith. No waiver upgrade is confirmed today: the data's free-agent 'starting QB' Fernando Mendoza is still LV's backup this week, so skip that claim.

ir.why: Locked (Out, hamstring) until Tuesday morning when the week's games complete; then move him to IR and start Geno Smith in the superflex slot. Dr. Jesse Morse's Sept 21 read of Monday's MRI puts a likely grade 2 hamstring strain at up to 8 weeks out, with a grade 3 (season-ending) not ruled out; Chicago has not ruled him out for Week 3 (Sept 28) but is calling him week-to-week.

flags.what: Out, hamstring (non-contact, suffered vs MIN); outside medical opinion Sept 21 says up to 8 weeks, Bears say week-to-week
Questionable, knee — briefly left Sunday's game vs CHI but returned and finished with 23 carries for 105 yards; Sept 21 reporting says it was mostly precautionary and he's expected fine
IR, ankle sprain, inactive vs PIT
GB's clear RB2 behind Josh Jacobs, who is on the exempt/personal list — not an injury, just his depth-chart slot

watch.what: The data flags him as LV's free-agent starting QB, but Sept 21 reporting on the Raiders' Week 2 win over the Chargers confirms Kirk Cousins started and played well (19/29, 253 yds, 3 TD); Mendoza is still QB2 behind Cousins. Not a priority claim right now — re-check only if Cousins is hurt or benched.

Dropped by KUZ1 Saturday, still unowned (clears the wire 48h after the drop). Sept 21 reporting has him a healthy scratch behind Tony Pollard and Tyjae Spears with no role — doesn't beat Judkins or Lloyd on Danny's bench.

alerts.title: 🔴 Caleb Williams: hamstring could cost weeks
alerts.body: An MRI-based outside read published today (Sept 21) estimates a grade 2 hamstring strain, up to 8 weeks out; Chicago says week-to-week and hasn't ruled him out for Week 3. He's locked until Tuesday morning — then move him to IR and start Geno Smith at superflex.
